title: Simply Optimized Rebirth
description: An attempt to carry on the legacy of Simply Optimized
body:
# Simply Optimized Rebirth

[![Built on Simply Optimized](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.jsdelivr.net%2Fnpm%2F%40intergrav%2Fdevins-badges%403%2Fassets%2Fcozy%2Fbuilt-with%2Fsimply-optimized_vector.svg&n=-1)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop)

This modpack offers a streamlined, efficiency-first Minecraft experience inspired by the well-loved Simply Optimized. It bundles engine and rendering optimizations, bug fixes, and resource-saving tweaks that reduce CPU and memory usage while preserving vanilla gameplay and visuals. The result is smoother performance in large worlds and on lower-end systems without sacrificing stability or mod compatibility.

Ideal for both single-player and server use, the pack is configured to minimize conflicts and provide sensible defaults while remaining highly configurable for those who want to tune resource usage. It focuses on playing the game reliably—less about adding new mechanics, more about keeping the game running great alongside other mods.
# Main Focus

- Pure performance: 

# Performance and compatibility focus

It aims to improve performance without compromising overall compatibility with other mods if you want to add others later, the choice is yours
